The memo webhook notification flow is now fully understood.

The dispatch function is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, called from `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. The file path is `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`.

The dispatch function delegates to `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` from the `internal/webhook` package. The HTTP delivery is handled by that same package. The request-signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256 using the Standard Webhooks v1 scheme. Request headers include `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature: v1,<base64 hmac-sha256>`.
